note: Flat-tree recipe. Build each commit with git hash-object -w, mktree (mode 100644, names sorted bytewise) and commit-tree, with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 and the fixed identity and date below for author and committer; the target's parent is the base. No .taskman/ or other Corvint file exists in either tree.
